schema.content:
Table "Customers" {
  "customer_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "customer_name" TEXT
  "customer_details" TEXT
}

Table "Invoices" {
  "invoice_number" INTEGER [pk]
  "invoice_date" TIMESTAMP
  "invoice_details" TEXT
}

Table "Order_Items" {
  "order_item_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "product_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "order_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "order_item_status" TEXT [not null]
  "order_item_details" TEXT
}

Table "Orders" {
  "order_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "customer_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "order_status" TEXT [not null]
  "date_order_placed" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "order_details" TEXT
}

Table "Products" {
  "product_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "product_name" TEXT
  "product_details" TEXT
}

Table "Shipment_Items" {
  "shipment_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "order_item_id" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "Shipments" {
  "shipment_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "order_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "invoice_number" INTEGER [not null]
  "shipment_tracking_number" TEXT
  "shipment_date" TIMESTAMP
  "other_shipment_details" TEXT
}



Ref: "Orders"."customer_id" > "Customers"."customer_id"

Ref: "Order_Items"."product_id" > "Products"."product_id"

Ref: "Order_Items"."order_id" > "Orders"."order_id"

Ref: "Shipments"."invoice_number" > "Invoices"."invoice_number"

Ref: "Shipments"."order_id" > "Orders"."order_id"

Ref: "Shipment_Items"."shipment_id" > "Shipments"."shipment_id"

Ref: "Shipment_Items"."order_item_id" > "Order_Items"."order_item_id"
